The existing pub use model::* exposes the one real owner at the public autoresolve API; no alias or compatibility shim.
Leave combatant state, simulation/resolution loops and existing tests in autoresolve.rs. Preserve test modules, successful serialization, defaults, traits and data layout.
Move BestiaryHours import to the actual record owner; no other caller requires the parent import.
No baseline/registry/suppression/cache/CI selection change now. Inspect official relevant reductions only after hosted export.
No new tests, cases, assertions, fixture helpers, local project checks or new agent.
